bio_short: Final-year B.Tech CS student at SIT Pune (CGPA: 8.0/10). AI Research Consultant at Heidelai & Technowgreen. 5× published researcher across IEEE and Springer. CCNA certified.
bio_long:
I'm a final-year B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering student at Symbiosis Institute of Technology, Pune (CGPA: 8.0/10), specializing in AI project management, enterprise infrastructure, IT audit compliance, and financial systems engineering.

Currently serving as AI Research Consultant and Project Manager at Heidelai, where I lead cross-functional teams, manage sprint timelines, and optimize LLM token efficiency (30-40% reduction). I also consult at Technowgreen Solutions on enterprise IT deployment and governance compliance (GDPR, DPDP, HIPAA, SOC 2).

My research spans financial analytics, IT audit platforms, and API security. I designed Basel III and RBI NBFC/BFSI compliant analytics tools, and won 1st Rank at the PBL-2 Industry Conclave 2026. Published 5 peer-reviewed papers across IEEE ICETCI 2026 and Springer LNNS SCI-2026.

CCNA certified in TCP/IP, routing, switching, and network security. Currently seeking opportunities in AI/ML engineering, research, and infrastructure roles.
